UDEV Lantern Network

Lantern Network

Description

A town has N lantern posts arranged along one road. Post i contributes brightness ai when it is included in a powered segment.

A segment is a contiguous interval of posts. For a segment [l,r], its total brightness is

B(l,r)=∑i=lrai

Your task is to find the shortest segment whose total brightness is at least S.

The posts are numbered from 1 to N.

Input

The input consists of:

  • one line containing two positive integers N and S;
  • one line containing N positive integers, the brightness of each post in order.

Output

Print the length of the chosen segment, then its left and right endpoints, separated by single spaces. If no segment has total brightness at least S, print:

-1 -1

The answer must satisfy:

length = right - left + 1
sum(a[left..right]) >= S

Constraints

  • 1≤N≤200000
  • 1≤S≤1018

The largest possible brightness fits in a 64-bit signed integer.

1000000000 1000000000 1000000000

Sample Tests

TestInputOutput
18 17 2 7 1 8 2 4 5 14 1 4
Explanation

The segment [1,4] has brightness

2 + 7 + 1 + 8 = 18

and has length 4. Other valid segments of length 4 exist, but this one has the smallest left endpoint.

25 20 3 1 4 2 6-1 -1
Explanation

The total brightness of all posts is smaller than 20.

36 9 4 1 2 6 1 33 2 4
Explanation

The chosen segment is [2,4] and has brightness

1 + 2 + 6 = 9

No segment of length 1 or 2 is sufficient.

Additional observations

SituationRequired behavior
The whole array is the shortest valid segmentPrint 1 N
Multiple segments have the same lengthChoose the smallest left endpoint
No segment reaches the thresholdPrint -1 -1
The brightness values are always positive, which is why the left endpoint can move forward without reconsidering earlier posts.
Optional hint

Maintain a window whose total brightness is at least S, then try removing posts from its left side while it stays valid.

Formatting details

  • Separate the three printed numbers with single spaces.
    • Do not print a trailing newline before the endpoints.
    • Print -1 -1 only when no segment qualifies.
  • Use right - left + 1 as the length.
sum(a[left..right]) >= S
